summary: Oceanhawk Acquisition Corp., a blank-check company, filed an 8-K reporting the appointment of Jimmy D. Ford as an independent Class III director, effective August 17, 2026. The board was expanded from six to seven directors, and Ford was added to the audit, compensation, and nominating committees. This is a routine director appointment and committee assignment, not a special-situation event. No transaction, tender offer, activist campaign, or strategic review is disclosed. The filing contains only standard biographical and independence information.
